expectation_origin: Proposed exact provider-name policy and parent exploratory observations, recorded before this independent measurement. Not an inference of HGL semantics from native ZoneId construction.
rules: These eight strings are syntactically plausible zone names; ZoneId construction is expected to preserve their exact spelling without proving provider membership.
With a configured native provider, at_zone should accept the four exact identifiers/links and reject wrong-case and nonexistent names, including synthetic Etc/Unknown.
US/Eastern and America/New_York should retain distinct names despite identical offsets at the tested instant.
Observe ad-hoc JSON decoding separately; do not presume it is provider-validating strict decoding.
Historical Python canonical-type availability is tested without substituting datetime or custom wrappers.
